result.summary: The image shows a wide urban arterial with multiple travel lanes and a signalized intersection. While sidewalks and basic crossing infrastructure are present, the long crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands create a high-exposure environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Main intersection in the center background

hazards.name: Lack of Median Refuge
hazards.description: There is no protected space in the center of the wide road for pedestrians who cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the intersection

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area and reduce effective crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line markings to continental or ladder style for better visibility to approaching drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection adjacent to a commercial strip mall with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and curb ramps. However, the environment is car-centric, characterized by long crossing distances and wide turning radii that increase pedestrian exposure to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time in the conflict zone.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while turning right, posing a risk to pedestrians starting their crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane arterial road in a commercial area with high-visibility continental crosswalks and a small median refuge. Pedestrian signals and sidewalks are present, but the significant crossing distance and car-centric road design create a challenging environment for non-motorized users.

hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross at least six lanes of traffic, increasing exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: The bus stopped on the right side of the intersection can obscure pedestrians from drivers and vice versa.

hazards.name: Road Surface Cracking
hazards.description: Visible longitudinal cracks in the asphalt within the crosswalk area may cause tripping or difficulty for those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)

interventions.title: Pavement Maintenance
interventions.description: Repair the cracks and resurface the crosswalk area to ensure a smooth, hazard-free path for all users.
